#Islamabad: #SituationUpdate for 11 & 12 April 2026. #IslamabadTalks #Iran & #US. #ChampAlertsOnTheGo #CAOTG 

📍Local Holiday Announced in Islamabad & Rawalpindi on 11th April 2026. 
-----------------------------------------------------
📍Trails Closed. #ChampAlertsOnTheGo 
-----------------------------------------------------
📢Important Traffic Advisory/Red Zone, Extended Red Zone

Below Routes will remain closed. Rest will be functional unless there is a temporary VIP Movement. 
📍Kashmir Chowk Club Road to Zero Point Srinagar Highway. 
📍Srinagar Highway, Zero Point to Serena Chowk. 
📍Shakar Parian Road, Chandtara Chowk to 7th Avenue, 
📍Jinnah Avenue, Khayaban Chowk to Blue Area
📍Margalla Road from Faisal Chowk to Trail 3 will remain closed for traffic.
📍All government and private offices, markets located in the extended red zone will remain closed.

✅️To travel from Bhara Kahu to Islamabad or Rawalpindi, Faizabad, 9th Avenue can be used from Kashmir Chowk via Club Road. Citizens are requested to avoid unnecessary travel except in emergencies. Cooperate with law enforcement agencies. #ChampAlertsOnTheGo #CAOTG
-----------------------------------------------------📍Public Transport: 
Red Metro, all feeder routes services shall remain suspended on 11/04/26 in twin cities. 
-----------------------------------------------------
✅️ Motorways Open only closure on M14 reported. 

Keep a margin of 45mins to 1 hour before starting your journey. Avoid unnecessary travel & cooperate with LEAs. 
📢 Keep following #ChampAlertsOnTheGo #CAOTG for more updates.
